name: B10-0265/2025 (ECR) – Arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns Tanzania for arresting Tundu Lissu, the leader of the main opposition party, and says he is in danger in custody. It calls on Tanzania to release him immediately and to treat him fairly. It also asks Tanzania to respect democracy and to stop intimidating opposition figures and journalists. It urges the European Union to keep human rights in mind in its cooperation with Tanzania.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion and demands Lissu's release.
- It affects Tanzania's government and Tundu Lissu, who is in custody.
- Next, the resolution is sent to Tanzania, the EU bodies, the African Union and the East African Community.
